title: VIXEN configure provisioning needs an accurate queue memory profile and isolated cache setup
body: Fresh cmake configure -S VIXEN -B build/wsl -G Ninja with the dispatched YEROKET_ROOT/SHA override was initially queued as build and charged an 18GB class maximum before payload. Configure as light completed and provisioned Vulkan SDK/X11 locally, but the queue measured about 2.6GB peak against its 1GB light estimate and reported a memory breach. No product build ran outside the queue. Isolated setup also required manually copying read-only FetchContent source cache entries into this worktree and passing VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE and VIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR to avoid writing shared repositories. Provide a documented configure/provisioning resource with its actual reservation and automatic worktree-local dependency/cache roots; keep compilation in build.

title: GPU recipe fixture needs worktree-local artifacts and raw baseline oracle export
body: The required declared-position fixture wrote three fixed /tmp/declared_pos_N.png files, and the rva1 fixture exposed only optional PNG heatmaps, so a fresh strict GPU rounding witness could not compare raw outputs with the unmodified shader baseline. Route PNG artifacts through TMPDIR/current directory and add explicit BOUNDSCORE_GPU_ORACLE_DIR plus record/check modes for whole RGBA32F buffers; check never recaptures after a mismatch. Consolidate fixture artifact routing and before/after raw-buffer recording into the shared witness runner so lanes do not hand-wire these environment controls.

title: Occupancy consumer manually schedules certified coarse-cell reductions
body: The lane replaces per-op transfers with generated coverage, but still had to write block traversal, float-to-cell mapping admission, reduction counters and saturated-zero scheduling in the renderer. Consolidate this pure reduction schedule and its admission proof in compiler-owned generated data/code; retain byte-identical fallback. File: RecipeOccupancy.h DeriveOccupancyGridImpl.

title: GPU proof-profile admission needs a shared device and shader contract
body: The real-device witness had to query VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties and inspect FP32/RelaxedPrecision/NoContraction SPIR-V manually before using conditional generated proof profiles. Renderer tests now pass the explicit generated backend; other devices conservatively retain the source tape. Consolidate device/compiler obligations and admission into a generated or shared backend contract instead of repeating this test-side wiring.

title: Windowed capture producer overwrites a tracked edited sample document
body: The full serial RenderGraph capture fixture changed VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.edited.vxd (588 to 916 bytes). Saved the generated artifact in this worktree's .tmp and restored only this lane's capture-generated tracked delta; repeat after later captures. Fixture output roots currently route PNGs but not the editor's edited document. Route all capture-induced saves to a worktree-local temporary artifact directory so verification leaves source assets unchanged.

title: RenderGraph concurrency witness needs more than the queue's two-core allocation
body: Fresh baseline and final ctest --test-dir build/wsl -L RenderGraph -j1 under --credits 1 both failed FramePipelineTest.AdjacentFramesOverlapButCommitInSubmissionOrder with maxActive=1, expected >=2. TaskExecutor.cpp initializes workerCount+1 arena slots to reserve the admitting thread. Queued focused recovery with --credits 2 (four affinity cores) passed unchanged binaries. Final full suite uses two credits while CTest remains serial. Encode the suite's minimum affinity requirement in the shared witness/queue profile instead of making lanes diagnose and pass extra credits.

title: Generated duplicate identities need GPU non-interference certificates
body: Forwarding the new GPU profile exposed that rvcompact duplicate min/max folding lacks a GPU denormal-flushing non-interference certificate. The consumer generically gates duplicate folding to strict CPU/SIMD contracts; GPU retains the operator while using certified generated interval winners. Declared lowered-away no-ops remain admissible because they emit no execution. No opcode/output handling was added. Consolidate backend-specific duplicate admission and denormal-free producer requirements in generated proof metadata instead of the renderer backend guard.

title: Kernel snapshot override requires manual full-SHA expansion
body: Final documentation-tip configure supplied -DVIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE=372d459b and failed at VixenKernelSnapshot.cmake:23 because the override must be a full commit SHA. Corrected by git rev-parse HEAD and passed 372d459b2181be1f071598450c4d3ec8e8d13ef3 to the same queued configure; no snapshot gate bypass. This invocation error is ours. Consolidate a documented wrapper that resolves an unambiguous local commit to its full SHA before snapshot validation, so brief/report abbreviations cannot accidentally cause reprovisioning retries.
